verses.text: O YHWH, God of Hosts, until when will You smolder at the prayer of Your people?

verses.text: You have fed them the bread of tears, and caused them to drink with tears a third part.

verses.text: A vine from Egypt You pulled out; You drove out the nations and planted her.

segments.text: A vine from Egypt You pulled out; You drove out the nations and planted her.

verses.text: You cleared before her face and let her root take root, and she filled the land.

segments.text: You cleared before her face and let her root take root, and she filled the land.

verses.text: The hills were covered with her shade, and the mighty cedars with her branches.

segments.text: The hills were covered with her shade, and the mighty cedars with her branches.

verses.text: She sent out her branches to the Sea, and her shoots to the River.

segments.text: She sent out her branches to the Sea, and her shoots to the River.

verses.text: Why have You broken down her walls, and all passing by the way pluck her fruit?

segments.text: Why have You broken down her walls, and all passing by the way pluck her fruit?

verses.text: The boar from the forest tears at her, and the wild beast of the field feeds on her.

verses.text: O God of Hosts, return, we pray! Look down from the heavens and see, and attend to this vine,
